rationale: The blind translation is a mathematically coherent generic theorem that a perturbation smaller than a lower injectivity bound preserves injectivity. It captures the core argument behind only the full-rank portion of Lemma 3.2. It omits the condition-number bound, exact epsilon_2 definition, pseudoinverse and spectral condition number, inherited construction and dimensions, and finite-precision forward-substitution provenance. Its arbitrary binders and zero-dimensional cases also make it more general along dimensions where the paper is specialized. Because it is simultaneously broader in scope and weaker in conclusion, neither statement implies the other as stated, so the appropriate classification is not-faithful-different.
